# DSL op directory · Assembly & Misc（part/joint/material + collision/inertial/animation/texture）

把 shape 包成可装配 part、URDF joint、材质、简化碰撞体/惯量、动画 clip、贴图。几乎每个 PART 收尾组装都要用到，视为必读的一部分。

Every op below is a DSL statement `id = op(args)`. Legend: `*` = required, `?` = optional; after `:` is the accepted arg kind(s). This is a shard of the full op directory — see [../op-directory.md](../op-directory.md) for the family index.

- `animation(name?:string, fps?:number, loop?:bool, q_json?:string, keyframes?:string, root_motion?:string, duration?:number, interpolation?:string, q_path?:string)` — 动画 clip：骨骼旋转 q(t) + 可选角色根位移。通道键既可是 URDF 关节名（机械路），也可是骨骼名（角色路，绕轴弧度）。root_motion 是模型根帧（Z-up、+X 向前）中相对根骨 bind position 的米制稀疏位移关键帧。
- `collision(link*:ref, box?:list, cylinder?:list, sphere_radius?:number, shape?:ref, origin?:list, rpy?:list, name?:string)` — 为 part 附加一个简化碰撞体（box / cylinder / sphere / 或 mesh ref）；URDF 编译时变成 <collision>
- `inertial(link*:ref, mass*:number, origin?:list, rpy?:list, ixx?:number, ixy?:number, ixz?:number, iyy?:number, iyz?:number, izz?:number)` — 把质量 / 惯性张量 / 质心 attach 到指定 part；URDF 编译时变成 <inertial>
- `joint(type*:string, parent*:ref, child*:ref, origin?:list, rpy?:list, axis?:list, lower?:number, upper?:number, effort?:number, velocity?:number, mimic_joint?:ref, mimic_multiplier?:number, mimic_offset?:number)` — URDF joint：连接两个 part；type=fixed/revolute/continuous/prismatic/planar/floating
- `material(rgba?:list, texture?:ref, metalness?:number, roughness?:number)` — RGBA 颜色 / PBR 材质；可选 texture(ref) 贴图（只在 g_bake_object 烘 GLB 时生效）
- `part(shape*:ref, material?:ref, origin?:list, rpy?:list, mass?:number)` — URDF link：把一个 shape 包成可装配的 part；可选 material/origin/mass
- `texture(image*:string, repeat?:list, offset?:list, rotation?:number)` — 贴图定义：image 路径（相对工程 assets/textures/）+ repeat/offset/rotation

_7 ops in this shard._
